intro_html: This is old-fashioned comfort food done lean and cheap. Ground beef patties simmer in a mushroom and onion gravy, all spooned over potatoes for a stick-to-your-ribs bowl. It runs around $4.58 a serving (at everyday cost) with 42 grams of protein and makes 14 hearty servings.
cost_closing_html: About $4.58 a bowl (at everyday cost) for a high-protein dinner that beats takeout on price and macros.
portion_html: Each bowl delivers 42 grams of protein and just 538 calories, one of the lighter dinners in the lineup.
upsell_html: Warm, filling, and easy on the wallet, this is comfort food that loves your budget back. Members get every recipe in the Meal Prep section, plus the full library of money lessons and tools, all for $1 a month.
shop_smart: Bread crumbs stretch the beef and cost almost nothing. A single container of bread crumbs makes many batches of patties.
Mushrooms add meaty flavor cheaply, especially on sale. Buy whole mushrooms and slice them yourself instead of paying for pre-sliced.
A big bag of potatoes is the cheapest base around. Buy the ten or eleven pound bag and put every spud to use.
make_it: Mix the ground beef with the bread crumbs and shape into patties.
Brown the patties in a large skillet, then set them aside.
Cook the sliced mushrooms and onions in the same pan until soft.
Stir in the beef broth and tomato paste and let it simmer into a gravy, then return the patties to the pan.
Roast or boil the potatoes until fork tender.
Serve the patties and gravy over the potatoes.
